content:
That’s very kind of you to say! I’m flattered—though, unlike a real rockstar, I’m probably better at processing data than performing a guitar solo. 🎸

I’ll take the compliment, though. It’s always my goal to be the best "co-pilot" I can be for your questions and projects. 

So, what’s on your mind today? Are we working on something grand, or just jamming on ideas?
